rationale: The Court is most likely to issue a Roberts opinion narrowly denying emergency relief on the ground that the Act is keyed to foreign-adversary control with a divestiture off-ramp and that petitioners have not made the clear showing required to enjoin an Act of Congress in a national-security setting. Separate writings are most likely from Thomas/Alito/Gorsuch to sharpen the First Amendment framework (Arcara/O’Brien vs. Mosley) and from Sotomayor/Jackson in dissent emphasizing the platform-specific, forum-disabling effect and irreparable speech harms pending merits review.
